notes.title: 1.0.1 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed various stability issues during game initialization
[*] Resolved player list display inconsistencies
[*] Improved handling of disconnected players during matches
[*] Enhanced game state synchronization between players
[*] Fixed a number of smaller issues
[/list]

[b]Technical Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Connection Stability: Improved network reconnection handling and reduced connection drops
[*] Authentication: Made the startup sequence more reliable with better error handling
[/list]

[b]Game Balance Updates[/b]

[list]
[*] Card Drop Rates: Adjusted rare card drop chances to better balance the game economy and make matches more enjoyable
[*] Soul Drain Card: Fixed stability issues and improved reliability during matches
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]

[list]
[*] Matchmaking: Improved handling of game search timers and lobby states
[/list]

notes.title: Duel Legends is out now!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Duel Legends is out now![/b][/h2][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]The wait is over - [b]Duel Legends[/b] is officially live on Steam! You can now jump in and battle your way through the arenas.[/p][p]We want to thank all of you who wishlisted, followed, and supported us during development. Your feedback has been invaluable, and today we are proud to open the gates for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s next[/b][/h3][p]
This is just the beginning. We’ll continue to refine the game, add new content, and keep listening to your ideas. Please share your thoughts in the Community Hub and let us know what you would like to see in future updates.[/p][p]See you in the arena,
The Duel Legends Team[/p]

notes.title: Duel Legends release 18 September 2025
notes.content: [p][b]Duel Legends releases on 18 September 2025[/b][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Big news today. [b]Duel Legends[/b] is set to launch on [b]18 September 2025[/b] on Steam. We are excited to finally share the date with you.[/p][p]From day one you will be able to jump in, play, and see what we have been building.[/p][p][b]How you can help[/b][/p][list][*][p]Wishlist and Follow to get a notification the moment the game goes live.[/p][/*][*][p]Share the date with a friend who might enjoy Duel Legends.[/p][/*][*][p]Hang out in the Community Hub and tell us what you want to see next. [/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for sticking with us. Your support means a lot to our small team. We cannot wait to see you in game on 18 September.[/p][p][/p][p]Duel Legends Team[/p]

notes.title: Playtest has ended!
notes.content:
[b]Thank you to everyone who took part in the Duel Legends playtest! [/b]

We’ve collected useful data and feedback, which will guide our ongoing improvements and enhancements.

We also invite you to continue sharing your thoughts on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3059670/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] page — every bit of feedback helps us create a better game experience.

As a token of our gratitude, all playtesters will receive exclusive gifts upon the game’s release.

Thank you for your support and participation!

Duel Legends team

notes.title: Playtest is now LIVE!
notes.content:
We are ready to announce that the Duel Legends playtest is now live! We invite all interested participants to join us to experience the game firsthand and provide invaluable feedback. Your insights are essential in shaping the future development of Duel Legends.
Help us make Duel Legends better!

Duel Legends Team

notes.title: Upcoming Playtest!
notes.content:
Hello Duel Legends Community!

We're excited to announce that our [b]playtest [/b]will launch on 29th March at 12:00 (GMT+2)! 
Join us for a one-week playtest as we work together to catch bugs, test server stability and make game more fun before the official launch!

[h2]Playtest Details:[/h2]

[b]Launch Date & Time:[/b] 29th March, 12:00 (GMT+2)

[b]Other Time Zones:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]America/New York:[/b] 06:00
[*] [b]Europe/London:[/b] 11:00
[*] [b]Europe/Berlin:[/b] 12:00
[*] [b]Asia/Tokyo:[/b] 20:00
[/list]

[b]Duration:[/b] Servers will be online for [b]1 week[/b].

[h2]How will it help us?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Help us catch as many bugs as possible.
[*] Test our servers under real conditions.
[*] All playtesters will receive exclusive gifts at the launch of the game for participating!
[*] We'll also be conducting a feedback survey afterwards to ensure we make Duel Legends even better and more fun.
[/list]
Mark your calendars and get ready to duel! We can't wait to see you on the battlefield and hear your feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates!

— The Duel Legends Team
